title: [R3-6] Gate graph.supersede on COMPLETE disposition coverage within the preparation deadline
description:
FILED FROM THE THIRD HUMAN REVIEW OF PR #3 (anchored d01c3316, 2026-08-28: 'Request changes - do not merge', 12 P1 merge blockers + P2 follow-ups). Re-verified at HEAD a09b11fa by a read-only verifier; see the ruling memo in the epic channel. Reviewer's finding: R3-6 supersession partial lineage. Existing rows checked: task-32c1ba453469448d87bf0925b3590657(DONE) closesIt=false, task-9e52f850959342faa3d464eed3c35f34(DONE) closesIt=false, task-eacea969d636420b8f5c47304039e056(DONE) closesIt=false, task-069853689ed643988cfec2d689f7edb7(DONE) closesIt=false, task-c289b8fbcb9840968a9b3994e73b79a4(BLOCKED) closesIt=false. Gap this row closes: No row in any epic (searches: 'supersession coverage PARTIAL', 'supersede deadline lineage', 'PLANNING_DISPOSITION_UNKNOWN', 'disposition coverage COMPLETE', 'supersede revalidation', 'lineage disposition', 'R3-6' all 0 hits; all 93 rows of epic-072d85 enumerated; grep of every .moe/tasks/*.json for PARTIAL|deadlineEpochMs|dispositionDigest|PREPARATION_WINDOW_MS finds no non-DONE supersession row) requires (a) disposition coverage to be a readable field of the durable preparation generation, (b) graph.supersede to refuse when recomputed or stored coverage is not COMPLETE, or (c) graph.supersede to refuse when the command's decidedAt is past generation.binding.deadlineEpochMs. All three are uncovered.

REVIEWER (PR #3 third review, anchored d01c3316, P1 merge blocker R3-6): Supersession authorizes incomplete lineage disposition. PLANNING_DISPOSITION_UNKNOWN is deliberately converted into coverage "PARTIAL" (apps/daemon/src/planning/supersession-preparation-lineages.ts:59-70). Coverage is then discarded from the persisted generation, and supersede checks only the lineage roster/digest, not COMPLETE coverage or the recorded deadline (apps/daemon/src/planning/graph-supersede-facts.ts:131-169).

RE-MEASURED AT HEAD a09b11fa (2026-08-28, read-only; both files have zero commits since d01c3316 and are clean): the claim holds in full.
- lineages.ts:63-69 disposeLineages returns {coverage:"PARTIAL", digest: digestOf("lineages", lineages)} when buildSupersessionDispositions refuses PLANNING_DISPOSITION_UNKNOWN@SCHEDULER_SUPERSESSION_SET (packages/scheduler/src/supersession/supersession-dispositions.ts:77-80: any of the 6 SUPERSESSION_DISPOSITION_KINDS lacking a lineage). The PARTIAL digest hashes the lineage roster, not a disposition set.
- SupersessionPreparationGeneration (supersession-preparation-contracts.ts:90-94) has no coverage field. Coverage is hashed into factHorizonDigest (supersession-preparation-history.ts:96-108) and written as a top-level `coverage` key on the PREPARED event (supersession-preparation-ledger.ts:145-147), but foldPreparationHistory reads only payload.record and payload.horizonGraphEpoch (history.ts:172-181), so foldPreparationHistory(...).current exposes no coverage.
- graph-supersede-facts.ts:160-165 refuses GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_PREPARATION_DRIFT only on lineage-roster inequality or disposed.digest !== generation.dispositionDigest. disposed.coverage is never read. generation.binding.deadlineEpochMs (written at supersession-preparation-service.ts:218 as Date.parse(decidedAt)+PREPARATION_WINDOW_MS, 900000) has NO production reader in apps/ or packages/ (repo-wide grep; only the expansion family reads its own deadline at packages/core/src/expansion/expansion-approval.ts:285). graph-supersede-service.ts:211-214 passes readSupersedeFacts straight to composeAndCommit; graph-supersede-dispositions.ts:20-24 says the kernel asks only for a non-empty set, so nothing downstream catches either gap.
- GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_CODES (graph-supersede-contracts.ts:33-41) has no INCOMPLETE or EXPIRED code; graph-supersede-refusals.test.ts:96 pins the roster at 15.
- REACH: supersession-preparation-service.test.ts:305-309 pins dispositionCoverage==="PARTIAL" as the delivered outcome and journey-authority-bodies.ts:157-161 throws on a second node id, so EVERY production preparation at HEAD is PARTIAL and the accepted control in graph-supersede-service.test.ts (fixture supersedableStore, graph-supersede-test-fixtures.ts:72) activates a successor over a PARTIAL set. lineageFactsFor (history.ts:119-130) classifies every lineage as ADD with hardcoded CREATED/null/terminal facts, which is why the set can never be COMPLETE at HEAD.

WHAT CLOSES IT: (1) coverage becomes a readable field of the durable generation and of the fold; (2) preparationFacts refuses unless BOTH the stored and the recomputed coverage are COMPLETE; (3) preparationFacts refuses when the command's own decidedAt is past deadlineEpochMs (no clock, same shape as expansion-admission-service.ts:187 + expansion-approval.ts:285); (4) the accepted control must be a real-store COMPLETE preparation built through production writers. If no production producer at HEAD can reach COMPLETE, that is a finding to surface as a named prerequisite (a durable-fact lineageFactsFor / multi-node graph producer), NOT a reason to weaken the gate or fixture-inject COMPLETE. Reviewer measured d01c3316; re-measure at the SHA you plan against before editing.

DRILL: two real-store arms against one prepared world - decidedAt = deadlineEpochMs + 1 ms refuses EXPIRED with zero events and the generation still current; decidedAt = deadlineEpochMs exactly does NOT refuse on the deadline (boundary arm). Mutant '>' to '>=' must redden the boundary arm; deleting the compare must redden the +1 ms arm. The expired arm's fixture must be COMPLETE-covered or the check must be ordered and documented so that only the deadline can refuse it (rail 7A).

Vocabulary fan-out (epic rail 7B): GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_CODES grows from 15 to 17, the closed-vocabulary arm at graph-supersede-refusals.test.ts:96 moves with it, and every artifact generated from or mirroring that roster (contract digests, generated clients, security boundary rosters if the layer is enrolled) is traced, listed as an owned path, and regenerated in the same commit; the request key set stays exactly 11 and GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_FORBIDDEN_KEYS stays 8 so no request can supply coverage, dispositions or a deadline. DRILL: the pinned-denominator arm reddens at 15 and 16 and greens at 17; a request adding a `coverage` or `deadlineEpochMs` key refuses GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_REQUEST_INVALID.

The one replacement accepted control in graph-supersede-service.test.ts is built through production writers over a preparation whose dispositionCoverage is measured COMPLETE by buildSupersessionDispositions, never fixture-injected, never via a widened disposeLineages, never via a relaxed scheduler kind roster; pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck and pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test run standalone and unpiped exit 0 with nonzero test-count lines. If COMPLETE is unreachable through production writers at HEAD (measure lineageFactsFor at supersession-preparation-history.ts:119-130 and the single-node producer at journey-authority-bodies.ts:157-161 first), report_blocked naming the exact producer gap as the prerequisite and the two new refusals stay landed and pinned; a green suite whose accepted control is PARTIAL-covered is a FINDING, not a pass.
